decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted   therewith (Drawing Numbers: 10248 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 07, 15, 16 , 17, 19, Design and Access Statement, received 08/09/09.10428 08 P02, 09 P02, 21 22, 27 (Mezzanine) received 13/10/10.10428, 06 10 PO1, 26, 27 received 26/10/10)  and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal/external feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 4 - Full details of any acoustic/thermal insulation and fire precautions works to demonstrate their effect on the character and appearance of the listed building shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of the development hereby permitted and the development shall be carried out in complete accordance with the detail so approved.

Condition : 5 - No works shall take place until samples of the materials  to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the works hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall be carried out in strict accordancewith the approved details.
description: Refurbishment and alterations to the Victorian baths to convert the building to six live/work units
